Enum.name: GrabbableType
Enum.description: GrabbableType is an enum that defines the type of behavior an object has when grabbed.

EnumValue.description: The object faces the user when grabbed.
The object rotates around the Y axis to face the user (will not look up or down).

Component.name: GrabComponent
Component.description: A component that makes an entity grabbable within a defined region using normalized coordinates (0-1).

BooleanAttribute.name: enabled
BooleanAttribute.description: Defines whether the object can be grabbed or not.

EnumAttribute.name: type
EnumAttribute.description: The type of behavior an object has when grabbed (faces user, pivots on y axis, etc.)

BooleanAttribute.name: isGrabbed
BooleanAttribute.description: Whether the object is currently grabbed or not

FloatAttribute.name: minHeight
FloatAttribute.description: the minimum height an object can be held when grabbed

FloatAttribute.name: maxHeight
FloatAttribute.description: the maximum height an object can be held when grabbed
